On replacement or upgrade, record the actual installed version/source, collect exact notices and compare bytes against that source. Keep notices required by other retained versions. Ordinary future package dependencies retain package notices and use their established reporting path; this inventory does not vendor them.

Historical Flutter widget rendering loaded the host's open Noto Sans CJK font from ignored `.devhome/diagnostic-font.ttc`. That font is not an application asset or shared source; old screenshots are historical test evidence, not validation of the replacement native UI. Do not package or stage that temporary font.
